Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: {PlayerName}, good to see ya! What're you doin' here?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: You want to hang out with Tinker Bell and me?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Júúú!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: HA. Real funny!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: Say, you've got a little Pixie Dust on your clothes... Is this about Tink?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: Bestie? Oh, you must mean my best friend. And that's Tink!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Nejlepší kamarádka? To asi myslíš mou nejlepší kamarádku. A to je Tink!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: ...and the little fox was chasin' Goofy around 'cause his shoelaces were untied!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: ...a ta malá liška honila Goofyho, protože měl rozvázané tkaničky!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: That's a good one! Ha-ha— Oh! There you are, {PlayerName}!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: To je dobrý! Ha-ha— Aha! Tady to máš, {PlayerName}!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: Who woulda thought the three of us would be back together again, huh?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Na tuhle chvíli jsem ČEKAL/A!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: You two caught up really fast, huh?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Vy dva jste se fakt rychle sblížili, co?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: Me too, {PlayerName}! I'm so happy I could fly clear through the clouds!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: To zní zábavně! Jdeme na to!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: Come on! Follow— Oh, wait. {PlayerName} can't fly!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: No tak! Následuj mě— Počkej. {PlayerName} neumí létat!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Mohl bys jít beze mě...

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: A lot of... Hmm... CODFISH! Right, Tink?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: Right. Don't you remember from when you were little, {PlayerName}? To fly you need <Lore>10,000 codfish</Lore>!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Jasně. Nepamatuješ si to z dob, kdy jsi byl malý, {PlayerName}? K létání potřebuješ <Lore>10 000 tresek</Lore>!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: I thought it was happy thoughts and Pixie Dust?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Myslela jsem, že to jsou šťastné myšlenky a Pixie Dust?

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.en: Well, I better get fishing!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Ne, už ne!

Expansion03Main_PeterPan/PeterPan_VLG_Ti.original_cz: Nechceš letět, {PlayerName}?
